title: KMSSchema
description: API contracts for interacting with the AIM Intelligence Platform KMS Grounding Index

query.description: Natural language query string to match against Federal Reserve regulations, policies, or swept pool definitions.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters to restrict search to 'Regulation', 'Policy', or 'Formula' nodes.

grounded_context.description: Grounded context compiled dynamically from SQLite vector similarity chunks and neighbor graph nodes.

matched_nodes.description: List of Graph DB node records traversed.

matched_chunks.description: List of Vector DB text chunks matched.
